summary: Frontend-only verification of date filter modes (Single / Range / Month) on Vendor Sales Report, Multi-Vendor Total Sales, and Admin Sales Report — including CSV/XLSX downloads for all three admin roles. All mode toggles reload the dashboard correctly, backends respond 200, downloads succeed, and file sizes differ between narrow (single-day) and wide (month/range) queries confirming the export honours the selected period. Master, Corporate, and Site admins all reach /reports/sales with correct scoping (Master ₹330, CorpA ₹210, SiteA ₹210).

issues: Downloaded CSV filename is built from fromDate/toDate state even when Single-date or Month mode is active (e.g. 'cravitoo_sales_2026-08-17_2026-09-16.csv' while a 2026-01-15 single-date CSV is being downloaded). File content is correct — only the filename label is misleading. Fix: build filename off params()/mode in download() so users can identify the file at a glance.

Downloaded Excel filename is always today's date ('cravitoo-sales-2026-09-16.xlsx') regardless of the selected mode/period. Same cosmetic issue as vendor CSV — content is correct but filename doesn't reflect the queried period.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Include the selected mode/period in downloaded filenames — vendor Reports.js download() and admin SalesReport.js Excel handler currently hard-code fromDate/toDate or today, hiding the true period from the user.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.js line 95: filename uses fromDate/toDate directly instead of computing from mode/singleDate/month — misleading in single/month mode.
AllOutletsReport.js line 58: correctly branches filename by mode — good pattern to mirror in Reports.js.

Backend vendor_reports._parse_date_range caps range at 366 days (line 66). Confirmed working — a 2-year manual range returns HTTP 400 cleanly. UI has no client-side guard so user sees console 400s + generic 'Download failed' toast; consider disabling the CSV button or showing a helpful message when the selected range exceeds 366d.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the mode-filter feature (all 3 modes on all 3 reports reload summary+tables and downloads succeed with period-matching totals)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Vendor operator's data lives in month 2026-09 (2 orders / ₹330). CorpA scope=₹210, CorpB=₹120. Single-date probes must target a date with actual orders (Sep 2026) to see non-zero totals; task hint of '₹330 on single day' didn't match the seeded orders here — single 2026-09-15 was ₹0 and month/range 2026-09 was ₹330, meaning the two seeded orders are on different Sep days. Vendor CSV backend enforces max 366-day range (HTTP 400 otherwise).
rca of the issue: No functional bug found. Only cosmetic: download() functions in Vendor Reports.js and Admin SalesReport.js don't rebuild the filename from the currently-active mode/period, so the filename is stale/misleading. Fix is a one-line branch akin to AllOutletsReport.js line 58.
